term: full ancestry foundation versus contingent-only ancestry foundation
resolution: ConeWellFounded constrains every selected-world ground edge between actual concrete cone members. ContingentConeFounded constrains only the contingent-to-contingent arrows in the same cone, represented as tagged existence facts using the same Ontic. The former implies the latter; a necessary-cycle interpretation separates them while retaining an actual contingent target and local dependence. The weaker premise yields necessary existence, not the earlier root/underivedness conclusion. Stopping this deduction when a necessary witness is found does not exempt that witness from PSR or assert its own explanatory adequacy.
